quote: we treated 104 genotyped segregants from a cross between two yeast strains with a collection of 100 diverse small molecules
We used linkage analysis to identify 124 distinct linkages between genetic markers and response to 83 compounds
The linked markers clustered at eight genomic locations, or quantitative-trait locus 'hotspots', that contain one or more polymorphisms that affect response to multiple small molecules
We also experimentally verified that a deficiency in leucine biosynthesis caused by a deletion of LEU2 underlies sensitivity to niguldipine
a natural coding-region polymorphism in the inorganic phosphate transporter PHO84 underlies sensitivity to two polychlorinated phenols that uncouple oxidative phosphorylation
We stress that what follows are associations which must ultimately be verified.
